source: zone gates are natural breakpoints: parity/double dominance, ordinal rank, majority breadth; the only external number is the materiality floor
source_window: materiality floor: Biden 2022-03-01 .. 2022-05-30 median (anchor); scale from live overlap 2026-04-20 .. 2026-07-11

anchor.basis: Biden 2022 median daily GDELT share 0.78% of Belgian articles x measured core/GDELT scale 1.47

notes: Zones measure CROWDING-OUT of the day's political attention, in words: flooding = #1 with DOUBLE the mentions of the 16 other tracked figures COMBINED, across a MAJORITY of outlets; soaked = #1 and out-mentions all 16 others combined (parity); wet = a top-2 figure; puddles = a top-4 figure.

Every gate value is a natural breakpoint that means something by definition, not by tuning: dominance 1.0 = parity with everyone else combined, 2.0 = double; rank 1/2/4 = ordinal positions; breadth 0.5 = a majority of outlets. None of these can encode a desired outcome.

The share floor (pct, same 1.15% on every zone) is a MATERIALITY floor only: below a normal president's median day (Biden spring 2022, externally measured) no zone above dry can be claimed. It carries no exceptionality semantics.
No gate references Trump's own distribution, and no gate was tuned to make any zone rare or common: zone frequencies are an empirical outcome, not a design target.
The normal-presidency comparison lives on as a continuous readout on the site (N x the norm); it gates nothing.
